format: serialized prestige science-fiction war mystery / drama
premise: An ancient ideological war that civilization has buried beneath history begins to reassert itself through impossible military architecture, anomalous geometry, inherited memories and awakened war machinery. Theo, Rae and Adrian become linked to evidence that the forgotten conflict was not merely historical and that its systems can still choose, recruit and destroy in the present.
sourceLocked: Eight supplied teleplays form the Season 1 development source.
Each supplied episode is structured in three acts.
Theo's recurring tactile tic maps an absent tactical stylus through thumb-and-index-finger motion.
Rae repeatedly grounds herself by tracing geometric grids.
Adrian recognizes the buried war and initially treats knowledge of it as a containment burden.
Ancient military structures respond through geometry, resonance, heat and saturated spectral light.
Olyria-Prime, the Zenith Spire and the buried monolithic war architecture are established in the opening episode.
themes: history deliberately erased rather than truly ended
systems of war surviving their makers
denial as a form of containment
the moral cost of forced integration
storyRules: Preserve the supplied teleplays as the authoritative dramatic source for this ingest.
Physical action, dialogue and revelation should remain causally connected rather than reduced to lore exposition.
Ancient technology is materially dangerous and physically present, not mystical decoration.
Character-specific grounding gestures and body behavior are continuity elements.
Spectral color and anamorphic light are story-bearing environmental phenomena, not generic cyberpunk styling.
Do not convert development inference into locked canon beyond what the supplied scripts establish.
exploratory: Graphic-novel page adaptation and issue mapping.
